topic: Which enchanted creation would you discover?

files.name: 01.png
files.label: THE SUN MASK
files.must_show: A giant golden sun-face mask with radiant crown spikes occupies the foreground on a stone pedestal.
files.observed_subject: An oversized sculpted golden face mask with closed eyelids and radiating sun spikes is displayed on a dark carved plinth between burning braziers.

files.name: 02.png
files.label: THE FOREST GATE
files.must_show: A large gilded wooden double door with green glass panels fills the left foreground of an ancient tree.
files.observed_subject: An ornate arched wooden double door with golden vine carvings and green stained glass is set into a huge tree, with stone steps and lanterns.

files.name: 03.png
files.label: THE CRYSTAL THRONE
files.must_show: A large purple upholstered throne framed by glowing crystals is the unmistakable foreground subject.
files.observed_subject: A purple velvet royal chair with gold armrests stands before a towering fan of glowing violet crystals, with a waterfall visible to the right.

files.name: 04.png
files.label: THE GOLDEN PORTAL
files.must_show: A large golden glowing portal framed by an ancient stone arch is central and clearly visible.
files.observed_subject: A bright swirling golden light fills a tall carved stone doorway above steps, surrounded by flowering vines and lanterns.

files.name: 05.png
files.label: THE MOON CRADLE
files.must_show: A large translucent crescent-moon shaped seat with lavender cushions dominates the foreground.
files.observed_subject: A luminous clear crystal crescent shaped lounge with lavender cushions, hanging prisms and draped fabric sits on a raised circular stone base.
